summary: Iteration 78 — verified BUG FIX (membership 'Claim now' → benefit_not_found) and NEW FEATURE Phase 1 (Shop subscription plans + Pro-tier gating for memberships) end-to-end across the shared backend, web (design=radiolife), and mobile (Expo web preview). BACKEND (6/6 pytest cases green — /app/test_reports/pytest/iter78.xml): (a) GET /api/merchant/marketplace/subscription/plans returns 3 tiers with correct pricing + can_offer_memberships flags (starter=0/false, growth=2999/false, pro=9999/true); (b) POST /subscription/checkout with plan_id='growth' returns a Stripe checkout_url (https://checkout.stripe.com/...) WITHOUT completing payment; (c) POST /subscription/checkout with plan_id='starter' returns activated:true and checkout_url:null (instant activation); (d) POST /merchant/marketplace/memberships/items on a merchant with no membership_plans on Starter plan returns 403 {code:'membership_plan_required'} and on Pro/grandfathered returns 200; (e) BUG FIX: POST /shop/memberships/{id}/claim with entitlement_id (v2 key) succeeds and decrements remaining; (f) legacy alias benefit_id key still accepted by the backend claim endpoint. WEB (design=radiolife, cookie auth): demo@bigfm.dubai → /shop/memberships/biz_sample_funpizza → Coffee Club section shows Unlimited Coffee row (data-testid=mem-benefit-bnf_unlimited_coffee) with 'Claim now' button (mem-claim-bnf_unlimited_coffee); clicking it decrements 95/99 → 94/99 with NO 'benefit_not_found' alert. Merchant plan ladder /shop/merchant/subscribe?design=radiolife (rl-merchant-subscribe-page) renders plan-starter (Starter/Free/Start free), plan-growth ($29.99/month), plan-pro ($99.99/month with POPULAR and MEMBERSHIPS badges) — testIDs subscribe-starter/growth/pro all present, Starter shows no /mo. Onboarding: fresh registered user → /sell?design=radiolife (rl-sell-page) → filled form (sell-public-name, sell-legal-name, sell-cat-retail, sell-offer-products, sell-city, sell-points=150, sell-commission-agree, sell-submit) → routed to /shop/merchant/subscribe → clicked subscribe-starter → toast 'Your shop is live!' shown, plan activated instantly (Starter card flipped to 'Current Plan'), NO Stripe redirect. Membership gating: /shop/merchant/memberships?design=radiolife (rl-merchant-memberships-page) on the Starter-plan fresh merchant shows the upgrade gate + disabled Create button, and the Upgrade-to-Pro button navigates to /shop/merchant/subscribe. NOTE: the actual testIDs on this screen are mmem-upgrade-gate / mmem-upgrade-btn / mmem-save (double-m prefix) rather than the mem-* prefix in the review spec — see action_items. MOBILE (Expo web preview): demo-login-btn → /shop/memberships/biz_sample_funpizza → the same Unlimited Coffee benefit row (testID mem-benefit-bnf_unlimited_coffee) with Claim now (mem-claim-bnf_unlimited_coffee) → tap decrements 94/99 → 93/99 with 'CLAIMED!' celebration modal, NO 'Claim failed / benefit_not_found' alert. Full web-mobile parity confirmed for the fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Upgrade gate/button/save testIDs are mmem-upgrade-gate / mmem-upgrade-btn / mmem-save (double-m prefix); review spec asked for mem-upgrade-gate / mem-upgrade-btn / mem-save. Functionality correct — testID naming only.

Functional behaviour is fine; this only aligns with the review spec's selectors.
(Cleanup) Dead code: /app/backend/routes/marketplace_memberships.py line 363 has an unreachable `return {'items': out}` after the actual return on 361 inside my_business_entitlements — remove.

(Nice-to-have) When free-tier Starter is chosen after an existing paid Stripe subscription is on the merchant, code does not cancel the outstanding Stripe subscription (marketplace_subscription.py:75-85). Chain stripe.Subscription.delete(existing.stripe_subscription_id) inside the free branch to prevent phantom billing on downgrade.
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace_subscription.py free-tier branch is idempotent (upsert) but does NOT cancel a previous Stripe sub on downgrade — merchants who downgrade Pro/Growth -> Starter would keep being billed until they explicitly cancel.

marketplace_memberships.py::_can_offer_memberships grandfather rule uses count of membership_plans with no active filter — soft-deleted plans could keep grandfathering. Add active:True filter, or gate on both count>0 AND subscription_active=True.

Fix confirmed: web ShopMembershipsRadioLife.jsx:45 and mobile [id].tsx:58 both send entitlement_id, and backend ClaimBody accepts both entitlement_id and benefit_id (marketplace_memberships.py:366-386).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows on web + mobile; only a testID naming nit.

seed_data_creation: Registered 3 fresh users (iter78/iter78b/iter78c) and flipped onboarding_complete=True in mongo to bypass the /onboarding SPA gate. iter78c owns marketplace_profile 'Iter78 Test Shop' on plan=starter (subscription_active=True). test@'s merchant_subscriptions row now points at plan_id=growth status=pending from the restore path (Stripe not completed) but profile.subscription_active stayed True + 2 grandfathered membership_plans intact. demo@'s Unlimited Coffee entitlement was consumed twice today (95 -> 93/99 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The claim fix is applied on BOTH clients AND the backend accepts either field name. Do NOT complete real Stripe payments — subscription/checkout returns cs_test URL only. Fresh users hit /onboarding first (SPA gate on users.onboarding_complete) — DB-flip is the fastest bypass. Web MerchantMemberships testIDs use mmem-* prefix; mobile memberships-detail uses mem-* prefix.
rca of the issue: Bug root cause: the API's ClaimBody model previously only accepted benefit_id, but the /businesses/{id}/memberships response returns rows keyed by entitlement_id (v2 schema); both clients were sending {benefit_id: <entitlement_id value>} which never matched any e.benefit_id in the plan -> HTTP 404 code=benefit_not_found. Fix: backend ClaimBody now accepts entitlement_id + benefit_id alias and matches either e.entitlement_id or e.benefit_id; web ShopMembershipsRadioLife.jsx and mobile /shop/memberships/[id].tsx both now send entitlement_id. Verified: claim succeeds on both surfaces, remaining decrements, no benefit_not_found alert.
